Messages.Author: Matt Latham
Messages.Body:
Lets say combat is occuring between Walter Nash and Muaziz. In the second
round, can Walter Nash play a Skin like Steel prior to setting range to
prevent damage from the strikes that are coming? (IE Can Walt play a Skin
like Steel before Muaziz gets a chance to play Blood to Water to remove all
of Walt's blood, hence making it impossible for him to play Skin like Steel
after strikes)

Matt

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. He has no damage to prevent.

So the only time Superior Skin like Steel works against "future damage" is
in the case of additional strikes (ie the opposing minion strikes, Walt
plays skin like steel at superior, then the opposing minion blurs, the blur
strikes are prevented by a formerly played damage prevention card)

Is this correct?

Matt
